study type: Network meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials and systematic reviews
outcome: Efficacy of analgesics (for acute postoperative pain)
cohort: The study included 39,753 patients from 261 trials published between 1966 and 2016, who were undergoing any type of surgery (72% dental).
finding: Network meta-analysis and Cochrane indirect analyses provided very similar results regarding the efficacy of analgesics in acute postoperative pain, thus increasing confidence in these efficacy estimates.
